final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT o.dealedge, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM riskandmargin r JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.dealedge), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) as avg_cnt FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT s1.dealedge, s1.cnt, s1.cnt - s2.avg_cnt as diff FROM step1 s1, step2 s2 WHERE s2.avg_cnt IS NOT NULL AND s1.cnt > s2.avg_cnt) SELECT SUM(cnt) as result_sum, AVG(diff) as result_avg FROM step3
